PROP-attendanceze-inv-021.text: OAuth access_token cookie must be httpOnly and Secure in production to prevent XSS exfiltration.
PROP-attendanceze-inv-021.assertion: forall cookie('oauth_access_token'): cookie.httpOnly == true && cookie.secure == true

locations.note: oauth_redirect httpOnly cookie set explicitly with httpOnly:true and secure based on https check (lines 69-75). This is the only explicitly set httpOnly cookie in the OAuth flow.
Supabase session cookies set via Supabase SSR library (pendingCookies). Cookie security attributes are managed by @supabase/ssr — not explicitly set in application code.
